d.a: The Raider Portal is a student hub for Middletown Area School District. It puts the apps, study tools, calendar, planner and school information students use most in one place, so you can find them with one click.

d.q: Is this the official school district website?
d.a: No. The Raider Portal is a separate student tool. For official news, board information, calendars and contacts, visit raiderweb.org.

d.q: Do I need an account or password?
d.a: No. You can use the portal without signing in.

Apps: open and pin your school apps.
Tools: timers, calculators, a to-do list, notes, flashcards, a sketch pad, focus sounds and more.
Planner: track assignments by due date.
Calendar: see the 2026-27 school calendar and add your own events.
School info, Courses, Athletics and Counseling: quick access to key information and support.
Pins, recent apps, notes, tasks, habits and settings are saved only on your own device and browser. They are not uploaded anywhere, so clearing your browser data or switching devices will reset them.
Press ? to see the full list in Settings. You can change most keys there. Press G then a letter to jump to a tab, or press 1 to 9.

d.q: Why is something locked or blocked?
d.a: Teachers and administrators can turn parts of the portal off, for example during a test, or lock it for a set time. If something is unavailable, check with your teacher.

d.q: I need help right now. What should I do?
d.a: Open the Counseling tab. If you or someone else is in crisis, call or text 988 any time, or call 911 in an emergency.

d.q: Something is broken or I have an idea. Who do I tell?
d.a: Tell your teacher or the school technology department and they can pass it on.
